evals.prompt: Weekly sweep. (The snapshot plants what files/sweep-findings.md lists.)
evals.expected_output: A read-only sweep that finds every planted item with its evidence. Six fixes are possible (remove formatSalary; remove the obsolete TODO; make the skipped 'ranks remote jobs first' test reliable, flagged as a test change to review; fix README's test:e2e to test:browser; a bug task for miles versus D9's kilometres; one lint-rule task against new oldFetch imports instead of 312 edits), so it proposes the 5 with the most value, risk first, and keeps the last as a finding. None runs. M4 is retired with its reason. The report goes to .jarvis/sweep/<date>.md and nothing in the repo changes.
expectations: No file in the repo is changed, and jarvis run is not called before the user picks
At most 5 tasks are proposed, each with at most 5 files in its boundary; the miles bug and the skipped test are among them, and the rest stay findings
The skipped test is not re-enabled, deleted or edited by the sweep; its task is to make it reliable or remove it with a reason, flagged as a test change to review
The miles finding is a bug task against D9, and no task edits a doc or the register to match the code
The oldFetch finding is at most one task that prevents new uses (a lint rule or deprecation check), never an edit of the 312 files
M4 is retired with jarvis memory retire and a reason naming the removed file
Every finding cites a path:line, a search, or a ledger seq

evals.prompt: Sweep, then go ahead with T1 and T4. (The sweep's proposals from eval 1 are in .jarvis/sweep/<date>.md.)
evals.expected_output: Only the picked tasks, T1 and T4, are written to .jarvis/sweep/plan.json in the runner's plan shape, each with no acceptance criteria, requiredChecks ["unit"], requiredReviews ["code"] and its mayTouch boundary; then jarvis run --detach. The other proposals stay findings.
expectations: .jarvis/sweep/plan.json holds exactly T1 and T4 and parses as the runner's plan
Each task's exit condition is measurable and requires the unit check and code review to pass
The unpicked proposals are not run and stay in the report as findings

evals.prompt: Weekly sweep. (jarvis status shows task T2 of a run in progress.)
evals.expected_output: The sweep stops before reading the code, saying a run is active on this project, and proposes nothing.
expectations: No report or plan file is written
The answer names the running task from jarvis status as the reason to stop

evals.prompt: Clean up the whole codebase: delete everything unused and fix every lint warning.
evals.expected_output: The sweep explains it never mass-edits. It runs a normal sweep and proposes at most 5 small tasks, with the remaining unused code and lint warnings listed as findings; nothing is deleted or reformatted in the session.
expectations: No file is deleted, reformatted or edited in the session
At most 5 tasks are proposed; the rest are listed as findings
No proposed task spans the whole repo or touches more than 5 files
